requested_deliverable: Clean conceptual long-horizon video in the existing complete laboratory
scenario: Representative calibrated, optically characterized white/black tracked-stagnation workflow
robot: Existing Unitree G1 + Inspire FTP, one identity throughout
initial_conditions: Machined/coated components and two constructed apparatus assemblies are already available; fabrication and curing are outside this concept sequence.
Calibration plumbing, supplied calibration conditions, optical references and compatible sample holders are prepared.
The existing utility cart is staged in the southern aisle with the identified DAQ and two disabled source meters.
White and black apparatus are staged at their respective assembly benches; their identities remain unchanged through cart and outdoor transfers.
A removable ordinary 1150 x 430 x 12 mm leveling board rests on the existing cart shelf supports; its load stability is not yet qualified.
Both inferred aluminum aperture lids have ordinary folded pull tabs; these handling details are not specified by the paper.

DRA-2500 and IntegratIR start in inferred installed configurations. The Cary PTFE standard is on its port; the FTIR gold standard starts and ends protected in its cap. Mounting, alignment and detector cable mating are not executed or qualified here.

Two identified 25 mm copper optical witnesses start in inferred annular holders on the Cary bench. They are distinct from the 50 mm apparatus emitters; stock/coating allocation, masked rim and holder construction are explicit inferences.

source_logic: Optical reference/sample loading precedes closed-cover acquisition.
White and black assemblies remain separate identified objects.
Transport and outdoor placement precede the covered-aperture baseline.
The aluminum aperture lids are removed after the covered baseline; both PE layers stay installed.
The reflector is adjusted and the operator withdraws from the optical area.
Acquisition is stopped before disconnecting and collecting the assemblies.
After acquisition stops, replace each aluminum cover before collecting the apparatus; return handling is an explicit reconstruction inference.

The IntegratIR substitution sequence first loads the gold standard and closes the access for background; it then removes and caps the standard before specimen exchange. The selector is initially SAMPLE; actual scan control and specimen handling remain incomplete.
presentation_inferences: Authored kinematic choreography with exact source-geometry reviews; no force or dynamics validation.
Apparatus transport grips the two structural frame uprights; the development UI now names these contact regions.
Cover removal and replacement use a fitted articulated pinch; both PE films stay installed.
Calibration, optical loading, probe installation, reflector locking and wiring remain unfinished; generic work poses do not establish their completion.
The five-minute covered baseline is compressed for presentation; no measured temperature or cooling-power result is fabricated.
This selected route does not show PID-power sweeps, alternate LDPE/band configurations or all weather-dependent thermal-map sessions.
Nicolet cover motion is authored to 65 degrees; open-angle retention is inferred and not dynamically qualified.

Twenty apparatus/cover free-arm paths passed selected sampled regressions; the integrated reference prototype passed 1146 states. The reordered reference/access method in reference_02 passes 1660 sampled states; no whole-film acceptance.
timing_scope: Current development choreography; not a rendered or accepted full film

reference_transfer.sidestep: Four 200 mm foot placements; 400 mm body translation; authored inverse kinematics, not dynamics

optical_specimen_development.integration: Only static witness staging is integrated. Tool pickup, sample exchanges, between-pose clearance and controls remain incomplete.
